note: The DECLARED layer of every table row, read off the tables by tools/sync/gen_layers.py (goal invariant I7). stub = the D2 stub, answers a shape-correct empty value and records a stub hit; slot = real per-instance storage with nothing computing it (a registry row's on* handler pair or writable-attribute slot accessor); native = a Rust body or a WebIDL constant; cppgc = realised by a cppgc class template and VERIFIED against the row. `install::installer::mounted_layer` derives the same four at runtime from the same columns; core/korvus-runtime/tests/layers_live.rs asserts the two never disagree. PER REALM, because the one registry's rows carry an `exposed` column and the two realms expose different member SETS (DOMMatrix.setMatrixValue is window-only); a hand table is realm-agnostic and appears in both.
